privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: This policy explains how {appName} handles your account, the photos you upload, the videos we generate and the credits you use.

whoWeAre.title: Who we are
whoWeAre.content:
{appName} is an online service that turns your photos into short videos using ready-made templates. We operate the website and the account, storage and generation service behind it.

This policy covers the website and the generation service.

informationCollect.title: Information we collect
informationCollect.content:
Account information: your email address, name and sign-in method, and, if you sign in with a third-party provider, the basic profile it shares.

Content: the photos you upload and the videos generated from them.

Usage and device information: pages visited, approximate location from your IP address, browser type and a device identifier used to prevent abuse of free credits.

Payment information: purchases are handled by our payment provider. We receive the purchase record, not your full card details.

howWeUse.title: How we use information
howWeUse.content: We use your information to provide the service: to sign you in, generate the videos you request, store them in your account, process payments and credits, provide support, prevent fraud and abuse, and improve the service.

photosAndVideos.title: Photos and generated videos
photosAndVideos.content:
When you generate a video, your photos and the template's reference clip are sent to our video generation provider to render the result. The provider processes these files only to complete your request.

People in the photos can be recognized in the result. Upload a photo only when you have the right to use it and the person has agreed to appear. Do not upload photos of children.

Generated videos are AI recreations and may be imperfect. They are not statements by the people in the photos.

informationSharing.title: Sharing
informationSharing.content: We share information only with service providers that help us run the service (hosting, storage, email, payments, analytics and video generation), when the law requires it, or to protect the rights and safety of users and the service. We do not sell your personal information.

dataRetention.title: Retention and deletion
dataRetention.content:
Uploaded photos are deleted automatically 30 days after the video is created. Generated videos stay in your account while it is open.

Email {supportEmail} to ask us to delete your account and the content stored for it sooner. We may keep limited records when the law, a dispute, fraud prevention or a payment requires it.

security.title: Security
security.content: We use encryption in transit, access controls and private storage to protect your information. No system is perfectly secure, so please use a strong, unique password or a trusted sign-in provider.

cookies.title: Cookies and analytics
cookies.content: We use cookies to keep you signed in and remember your preferences such as language and theme. If analytics is enabled, we use it to understand how the site is used in aggregate.

yourRights.title: Your rights
yourRights.content: You can ask us to access, correct, export or delete the information we hold about you. Email {supportEmail} from the address on your account. Depending on where you live, local law may give you additional rights, including the right to complain to a data protection authority.

children.title: Children
children.content: The service is not directed to children under 16. Do not create an account or upload a photo if you are under 16, and do not upload photos of anyone under 16. If you believe we hold a child's data, contact us and we will delete it.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: These terms are the agreement between you and the operator of {appName}. Signing in or generating a video means you agree to them.

theService.title: The service
theService.content: {appName} lets you pick a video template, upload photos and receive a short generated video. Generating a video uses credits; the cost is shown before you start.

accountResponsibilities.title: Your account
accountResponsibilities.content: Keep your sign-in details secure and tell us about any unauthorized use. You are responsible for activity under your account. One person per account.

photosAndConsent.title: Photos and consent
photosAndConsent.content: Only upload photos you have the right to use, of people who have agreed to appear in a generated video. Do not upload photos of children, of public figures, or that you do not have rights to.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable use
acceptableUse.content: Do not use the service to create content that is illegal, harassing, sexual, deceptive or that impersonates someone, and do not try to break, overload or reverse-engineer the service. We may refuse or remove content that breaks these rules.

intellectualProperty.title: Content and rights
intellectualProperty.content: You keep the rights you have in your photos and give us a limited permission to process them to provide the service. You may download, keep and share the videos generated for your account, provided you respect the rights of the people in them and the rules of the platforms where you post. The service, its templates and site content remain ours.

billingAndRefunds.title: Credits, payments and refunds
billingAndRefunds.content: Credits are bought in one-time packs and are used when you generate. If a generation fails, its credits are returned automatically. Purchases are otherwise final except where the law requires a refund.

disclaimers.title: Disclaimers
disclaimers.content: Generated videos are produced by AI and may contain errors or artifacts. The service is provided as is, without warranties of any kind to the extent the law allows.

liabilityLimit.title: Limitation of liability
liabilityLimit.content: To the extent the law allows, our total liability for any claim is limited to the amount you paid us in the 12 months before the claim.

termination.title: Termination
termination.content: You can stop using the service at any time. Email {supportEmail} to close your account. We may suspend or close accounts that break these terms.

changesToTerms.title: Changes
changesToTerms.content: We may update these terms. If a change is material, we will notify you before it takes effect. Continuing to use the service means you accept the updated terms.
